name: Umino Riki
source:
3rd year Japanese Cuisine student.
The fashionable one at the boarding house.
His hobby, being fashionable, his special skill DJ'ing.
He can talk to anybody with an easy rhythm and is a nice guy who everybody loves.
Out of all the ones at the boarding house he seems the least serious.
